title.en: I am doing (present continuous) and I do (present simple)
title.hy: I am doing (present continuous) and I do (present simple)
title.ru: I am doing (present continuous) and I do (present simple)

explanation.en: Present continuous (I'm doing = now) or present simple (I do = in general, often, every day)? And verbs we do not use with -ing: like, want, know, understand ...
explanation.hy: Present continuous (I'm doing = հիմա), թե՞ present simple (I do = ընդհանրապես, հաճախ, ամեն օր)։ Եվ բայեր, որոնք -ing-ով չեն գործածվում. like, want, know, understand ...
explanation.ru: Present continuous описывает действие сейчас, а present simple — привычки и общие факты. Глаголы состояния обычно не употребляются с -ing.

explanation.en: Present perfect for experiences — a time from the past until now: Have you ever been to Thailand? I've never ridden a horse. And gone or been.
explanation.hy: Present perfect՝ կյանքի փորձի մասին (անցյալից մինչև հիմա). Have you ever been to Thailand? I've never ridden a horse. Եվ gone, թե՞ been։
explanation.ru: Present perfect используют, чтобы говорить об опыте до настоящего момента. Been подчёркивает посещение и возвращение, gone — отсутствие после ухода.
